ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the diagram, which organism would most likely have a decrease in its population if the population of ants decreased?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, plant is at the top. plant has an arrow pointing to ant on the left, and also has an arrow pointing to poison dart on the right. Below ant there is an arrow directly pointing to lizard. On the right, there is also poison dart pointing to leimadopis epinephlos, then pointing to the goliath bird eating spider. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows point from food or an energy source to the eater. Because the arrow of ant in the figure points to lizard, this shows that lizard depends on ants as a food source. Therefore, if the number of ants decreases, the food of lizard decreases, and the population size of lizard is most likely to decline.
